Multi-threaded fill dispatcher — the star-field's heavy

UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

Merged fill result — flat interleaved buffers the caller writes into geometry attributes (pos xyz triplets, col rgb triplets). Chunks that compact variable-length output (belt rejection sampling, the deep-field sentinel drop) return kept — the merged buffers are sliced to the true point count by the caller via count.

kept

Live vertex count after in-chunk compaction (≤ requested count).

(module scope)

Worker reply envelope shape — results carry typed arrays (transferred).

(module scope)

Dispatches one buffer fill to the worker pool, chunked by index range for true multi-threading. base carries the job's constant payload — seed, geometry params and the p-token map the worker mirrors — plus count records split into ≤MAX_CHUNKS equal ranges. Replies merge in order into one pair of typed arrays; any failed chunk (null reply, malformed length) voids the whole result so the caller falls back to the identical local fill rather than mixing partial buffers.

  • @param action WASM_ACTIONS message type the worker dispatches on.
  • @param base Constant job payload shared by every chunk.
  • @param count Total record count to fill across chunks.
  • @param fixedLen When true every chunk must return exactly its range
  • @returns Merged fill buffers, or null on any failure → JS fallback.
